name: Sunteck Realty Ltd
title: Sunteck Realty Ltd - 512179 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Q1 FY27 presales rose 20% YoY to INR787 crore and EBITDA grew 40% to INR67 crore at a 35% margin; FY27 presales guided up 25-30%.
summary.overview: Presales were INR787 crore, up 20% YoY, with collections up 17% YoY to INR409 crore. Operating revenue was INR191 crore (vs INR188 crore), while EBITDA rose 40% to INR67 crore (35% margin) and PAT rose 26% to INR42 crore (22% margin). Net cash flow surplus was INR193 crore, up 79%, after INR170 crore of business development and land capex. Management reiterated FY27 presales growth of 25-30% and said the Dubai project is launch-ready but its timing is being recalibrated because of the ongoing external situation.

+17% YoY vs INR351 crore in Q1 FY26
vs INR188 crore in Q1 FY26 (about +2%)
+79% YoY, after INR170 crore BD and land capex
Stated as stronger than the past 12 months

segments.name: Presales mix by segment
segments.commentary: Uber luxury 29%, premium luxury 50%, aspirational luxury 21% of Q1 FY27 presales. Management says embedded EBITDA margin on FY26 and Q1 FY27 presales is 35-40%.

segments.name: Aspirational luxury
segments.commentary: Sales came from Naigaon and Kalyan with no launch in the quarter; management attributes the pickup to lower interest rates and early signs of recovery.

segments.name: Premium luxury
segments.commentary: Sunteck City, Sunteck Sky Park (Mira Road) and Sunteck Beach Residences (SBR) contributed INR391 crore of presales in the quarter, and SBR was the only launch.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales growth guided at 25-30% YoY, with management saying it is confident the full year will meet this despite 20% growth in Q1.
Collections expected to grow at a similar 25-30% in FY27 and to accelerate; the bigger step-up depends on starting construction at Nepean Sea Road.

Non-Dubai to-be-launched pipeline of about INR7,000-7,100 crore is targeted for launch in FY27, including ODC additional tower, Andheri redevelopment, Mira Road 2, Vasai (one more tower) and Naigaon (1-2 towers).
Business development spend in FY27 expected to exceed the FY26 level of more than INR800 crore.
Sunteck OneWorld and additional floors at 4th Avenue, 1st Avenue and Pinnacle to be delivered in FY27; additional floors take about 3-6 months to complete.
Commercial component at 5th Avenue ODC to start soon; residential targeted for delivery in about three years and commercial in 24-30 months.
capex_capacity: Dubai project (next to Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa Community Downtown) has all regulatory approvals and is launch-ready, but launch timing is being recalibrated; management says its to-be-launched GDV of about INR9,000 crore is excluded from the FY27 launch plan.
Management says investment in the Dubai project to date is about INR200-225 crore and that the project has no debt; cash flow will be repatriated to India when the market allows.
Q1 FY27 had no new project launches; launches are planned for Sunteck Sky Park 2 and Tower 2 of Sunteck City in the coming quarter.
Total GDV now split into Launched, To-be-launched and Upcoming-for-launch categories. Existing GDV gives several years of launch visibility before any new acquisitions.
INR170 crore of Q1 BD and land capex went to Nepean Sea Road, Mira Road 2 and certain redevelopment projects, partly as token money.
demand_pricing: Presales demand is well balanced across luxury tiers; growth in aspirational luxury is attributed to lower interest rates and early recovery signs.
Premium luxury presales of INR391 crore came from Sunteck City (Goregaon), Sunteck Sky Park (Mira Road) and SBR.
Management says the Kalyan market is picking up more strongly and the company has large GDV there, so it wants to monetise early.
Management said the embedded EBITDA margin of 35-40% on FY26 and Q1 FY27 presales will flow through to reported profit as projects reach revenue recognition.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Dubai project launch possible in FY27 or only in FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said all approvals are in place and the project is launch-ready; timing is being recalibrated because of the ongoing situation. Investment to date is about INR200-225 crore, with no debt on the project, and cash will be brought to India when it comes.

qa_highlights.question: What quantum of the to-be-launched GDV can be launched in FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Excluding about INR9,000 crore of Dubai GDV, the to-be-launched GDV is about INR7,100 crore. Management expects about INR7,000 crore of non-Dubai projects to launch this year. Uncertainty relates only to Dubai.

qa_highlights.question: What is the growth outlook for presales in FY27 and FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reiterated 25-30% FY27 presales growth, citing the pipeline. No FY28 figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the aspirational and premium luxury sales growth, and what launches are next?
qa_highlights.answer: Aspirational sales came from Naigaon and Kalyan with no launches in the quarter. Premium sales of INR391 crore came from Sunteck City, Sky Park and SBR. Next launches are Sunteck Sky Park 2 and Tower 2 of Sunteck City.

qa_highlights.question: What is the collections outlook, and what is the status of the Nepean Sea Road RERA approval?
qa_highlights.answer: Collections are expected to grow about 25-30%, with a bigger step-up once Nepean Sea Road construction starts. Trailing collections are close to INR1,500 crore. No RERA update was given in the answer.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BD spend plan and the delivery pipeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 BD spend of INR170 crore went to Nepean Sea Road, Mira Road 2 and redevelopment projects. FY27 BD spend is expected to exceed FY26's more than INR800 crore. FY27 deliveries include OneWorld and additional floors at 4th Avenue, 1st Avenue and Pinnacle.

risks_watch: Dubai launch timing is open-ended and the INR9,000 crore Dubai GDV is excluded from the FY27 launch plan; the situation is described only as 'ongoing'.
FY27 guidance of 25-30% presales growth needs a sharp step-up after Q1 growth of 20%; the Q1 launch pipeline was empty apart from SBR.
Collections growth depends on starting Nepean Sea Road construction, and the RERA approval status was not addressed.
A large BD spend is planned in FY27 (above FY26's more than INR800 crore), which could pressure cash flow.
The investor presentation's to-be-launched GDV note (about INR16,100 crore) was wrongly worded to say it covers only projects under approval; management agreed to edit it.
Net debt to equity is low at 0.07x, and an INR2,000-plus crore enabling resolution for debt and equity fundraising was passed but management says no fundraising is planned.
summary.management_tone: Confident on presales growth and the launch pipeline, but cautious and non-committal on Dubai timing because of the external situation. Management was open to corrections, agreeing to edit the GDV disclosure wording when questioned.
key_quotes: We have consistently maintained that we run the business on cash flow, not accounting revenue.
The embedded EBITDA margin on both our FY26 and Q1 of FY27 presales stands in the range of 35% to 40%, which will flow through to the reported profitability as the project reach revenue recognition.
Only the timing of the launch has been recalibrated due to the ongoing situation.
So this quarter, we didn't do any launch. In spite of this, we could do good aspirational luxury sales.

adds.what: Sunteck OneWorld and additional floors at 4th Avenue, 1st Avenue and Pinnacle (delivery in FY27)
Sunteck Sky Park 2 and Tower 2 of Sunteck City launches (coming quarter)

growth.why: Management reiterated FY27 presales growth of 25-30% (Q1 presales +20%), backed by a INR7,000-7,100 crore non-Dubai to-be-launched pipeline and INR787 crore of Q1 presales, though no capacity figures or timelines for the pipeline were quantified beyond launch and delivery windows; Dubai (~INR9,000 crore GDV) is excluded from the FY27 plan.
